column1: R1 - Always-on factors (trigger / contested / source clarity / arbiter / temporal / mutability) score every market; the one situational factor (source-conflict rule) scores only when 2+ distinct sources are named and is excluded from the denominator otherwise
R2 - Final = 100 x (earned applicable points / total applicable points); then band; then apply caps
R3 - Caps are CEILINGS - a cap at B means the grade cannot exceed B; a market can still score lower on its own merits
R4 - Expose the applicable-factor count with the grade (e.g. B - scored on 6 of 7 factors) for comparability across complexity

R5 - All five LLM-judged factors (trigger + contested + source-conflict + temporal + mutability) are scored in ONE per-event call (enhance.llm_rcg_factors) - adding factors adds tokens not calls; cost stays ~one call per event
R6 - Partial credit = half the weight carried UNROUNDED (temporal 3.5 / mutability 2.5); only the final 100x score is rounded
